summary: Consolidated desk rebuild after UPS battery disposal; badge reactivation and missing docking stations on inbound shipment
location: San Francisco - Warehouse Dock (Building 42) / Floor 3 hotdesk bay
description:
Issue summary:
Facilities team executed scheduled UPS battery disposal in Building 42 (custodial run 2026-03-09). During the operations we decommissioned two hotdesk kiosks and staged outbound equipment for return. On re-provisioning a returning contractorpermanent badge was inadvertently deactivated by the badge lifecycle script, and an inbound courier manifest (TRK: RW-834-5992) shows 3 docking stations (Dock-DS-44) listed but only 0 were present at the receiving bay.

Impact:
- One contractor (external IT contractor) could not access Floor 3 hotdesk area for onboarding scheduled 2026-03-10 AM.
- Desk rebuild delayed for three hotdesks; two desks require docking stations and PSU replacements.
- Potential inventory mismatch for 3 docking stations; outbound return manifest may be incomplete.

Steps taken so far:
1) 2026-03-10 08:40 - Facilities moved contractor to temporary hotdesk on Floor 5. Badge reactivation requested from Access Control.
2) 2026-03-10 09:05 - Security confirmed badge was deactivated by lifecycle job 'badge-rotation-2026-03' at 2026-03-09T23:45:12Z.
3) 2026-03-10 10:00 - Receiving scanned inbound courier and found 0 Dock-DS-44 units physically present despite manifest listing 3 items (manifest reference M-20260309-42).
4) 2026-03-11 14:12 - Shipping contacted carrier; carrier acknowledged scanning error at origin hub and opened trace (case C-55578).
5) 2026-03-12 11:30 - Facilities removed two UPS battery packs per disposal run; created disposal ticket and updated asset tracker (disposal receipts attached in Confluence runbook).

Investigation notes:
- Badge lifecycle job logged a scheduled deprovision for badge id B-99821 tied to contractor account 'ext-it-contractor-07' because onboarding record had a duplicate entry. Hypothesis: duplicate onboarding record triggered deprovision instead of activation.
- Inventory audit of outbound pallet (pallet ID P-42-038) shows three Dock-DS-44 entries in the outbound manifest but weight/box counts do not match physical scan receipts. Possible mislabeling or incorrect scanning sequence at origin.
- No PSU serials for the missing docking stations found in local asset DB; last-known serials were purged in a previous inventory cleanup (related: INT-33211).

Next steps / action items:
- Access Control (assignee: Diego Ramos) to: 1) re-activate contractor badge B-99821; 2) add exception rule to prevent lifecycle deprovision for any user with an active scheduled onboarding event.
- Shipping to escalate carrier trace C-55578 to urgent and request last-seen scan location; expected carrier ETA for update: 48 hrs. Add missing-tracking follow-up in 24 hrs.
- Facilities to reassign two spare docking stations from inventory (reserve pool ID: RES-DOCK-SPARE) for temporary desk rebuild; log temporary transfers and tag items to be reconciled once carrier trace completes.
- Inventory team to run a focused asset reconciliation for Dock-DS-44 SKU across warehouse zones A/B/C (owner: Priya Menon).
- Ops to review badge lifecycle job 'badge-rotation-2026-03' logic and patch duplicate-onboarding detection (owner: EngOps, link: https://github.com/redwood/ops-scripts/pull/4288 - placeholder).

Attachments / references:
- Inbound manifest: M-20260309-42
- Carrier trace: C-55578
- Receiving tracking: TRK: RW-834-5992
- Confluence runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/UPS+Batteries+Disposal+Runbook
- Related run: INT-33211 (inventory cleanup), INT-413212 (escorted courier note)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:10 - Diego Ramos (Access Control): Ire-activated B-99821 at 09:08 and temporarily lifted entry restriction for Floor 3 for today. Adding a flag to alert if lifecycle job touches this badge again.
2026-03-10 11:45 - Marcus Liu (Shipping): Carrier opened a trace; they report last known scan at SFO hub. Requested visual confirmation video; expected by 2026-03-12 14:00 PST.
2026-03-11 15:22 - Priya Menon (Inventory): Spares audit: we have 2x Dock-DS-44 in reserve; reserving both for hotdesk rebuild and marking them 'temp-assign'. Will reconcile when incoming confirmed.
2026-03-12 09:05 - Security (Jen Ortega): Noted badge lifecycle job config issue; will coordinate with EngOps to add onboarding exception. Tentative patch scheduled for 2026-03-16.
2026-03-14 08:18 - Asha Patel (Reporter): Confirming contractor completed onboarding on temporary desk; please keep ticket open until inventory reconciled and lifecycle job patched.
resolution_notes: Partial workaround applied: contractor badge reactivated and temporary docking stations assigned. Carrier trace is open for missing items; final reconciliation pending carrier resolution and patch to badge lifecycle job. Follow-ups scheduled: inventory reconciliation (Priya) and EngOps patch (ETA 2026-03-16).
